```lean
theorem lg_target {Ω : Type u_1} {m : MeasurableSpace Ω} {X : Ω → ℝ} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} : AnalyticOn ℝ (ProbabilityTheory.cgf X μ) (interior (ProbabilityTheory.integrableExpSet X μ)) := by
  intro x hxs
  apply AnalyticOn.exp_lintegral
  have h : x ∈ interior (ProbabilityTheory.integrableExpSet X μ) := hxs
  convert (ProbabilityTheory.integrableExpSet X μ).interior_subset
  exact h
  apply ProbabilityTheory.integrable_exp_lintegral
  convert (ProbabilityTheory.integrableExpSet X μ).interior_subset
  exact h
```
